reviewScope.binding: Reviews one release-boundary and current-state documentation successor on top of the certified runtime candidate. Application runtime behavior is intentionally unchanged. The exact successor HEAD/tree is recorded by the immutable release manifest after commit; this tracked review therefore binds the known certified runtime base and the bounded successor scope without attempting to self-reference its own commit SHA.
scope: Remove local-tool directory exceptions from distributable lint/format/ignore configuration after those local directories were moved outside the repository.
Define a deterministic git-archive source-package boundary that excludes internal repository/process material while preserving it in repository history.
Replace stale active release prose with a concise current-state ledger and keep the immutable release manifest authoritative for the final successor SHA/tree.
Do not change application source, tests, package manifests, lockfile, service worker, storage, XP, achievements, course data, dependencies, CSP, or runtime behavior.
evidence: Runtime base 07ae92a08abe87738986c418d2c0d603ee2a4005 passed the local immutable release gate on tree fe599050158c366d69b760f77e13270d43f2d150.
Independent GitHub Release validation / Final candidate succeeded on the same runtime-base SHA.
The Vercel preview for the same runtime-base SHA reached READY.

adversarialFindings.description: Working-directory source handoffs could include ignored local development-tool trees and generated artifacts, and tracked configuration contained exceptions specifically for those local trees.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Move the local development-tool trees outside the repository, remove their tracked lint/format/ignore exceptions, and create distributable source only with git archive from the exact final commit. Internal repository/process material is excluded structurally with export-ignore rather than by rewriting historical records.

adversarialFindings.description: Active release prose lagged the certified 07ae92a runtime state and hard-coding the final successor SHA inside files that determine that SHA would create a self-reference problem.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Record 07ae92a as the certified runtime base and make the immutable release manifest authoritative for the exact successor HEAD/tree. Keep documentation concise and current rather than appending another release chronology.

adversarialFindings.description: Automated local/remote certification does not replace physical-device ergonomics, human screen-reader evaluation, owner publication approval, or production hosted-origin validation.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Keep real iPhone/Safari, Android/Chrome, human screen-reader review, owner GO, and production hosted smoke/rollback as explicit publication prerequisites after the successor candidate is certified.

retrospective.summary: The runtime candidate is already certified locally and independently in CI. This successor is intentionally limited to source-package boundary, validation-configuration sanitation, and current-state evidence/documentation. Because lint/format/package-boundary configuration changes, certify the committed successor once locally and once in independent CI; do not reopen feature work or repeat unchanged gates.
